mapper.select: SELECT cr.report_id AS reportId, cr.reporter_user_id AS reporterUserId, reporter.nickname AS reporterNickname, cr.target_type AS targetType, cr.target_id AS targetId, COALESCE(bp.title, CONCAT('리뷰 #', br.review_id)) AS targetTitle, COALESCE(bp.content, br.content) AS targetContent, COALESCE(bp.status, br.status) AS targetStatus, COALESCE(bp.author_user_id, br.author_user_id) AS targetAuthorUserId, cr.reason_code AS reasonCode, cr.detail, cr.status, cr.moderation_action AS moderationAction, cr.resolution_note AS resolutionNote, cr.reviewed_by AS reviewedBy, cr.reviewed_at AS reviewedAt, cr.created_at AS createdAt FROM content_report cr JOIN user_account reporter ON reporter.user_id = cr.reporter_user_id LEFT JOIN board_post bp ON cr.target_type = 'BOARD_POST' AND bp.post_id = cr.target_id LEFT JOIN board_review br ON cr.target_type = 'BOARD_REVIEW' AND br.review_id = cr.target_id WHERE cr.report_id = #{reportId}
mapper.update: UPDATE content_report SET status = #{status}, moderation_action = #{moderationAction}, resolution_note = #{resolutionNote}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT us.sanction_id AS sanctionId, us.user_id AS userId, target.email, target.nickname, target.account_type AS accountType, target.account_status AS accountStatus, us.sanction_type AS sanctionType, us.status, us.reason, us.sanction_until AS sanctionUntil, us.created_by AS createdBy, us.revoked_by AS revokedBy, us.revoked_at AS revokedAt, us.revoke_reason AS revokeReason, us.created_at AS createdAt FROM user_sanction us JOIN user_account target ON target.user_id = us.user_id WHERE us.sanction_id = #{sanctionId}

SELECT sanction_id AS sanctionId, user_id AS userId, sanction_type AS sanctionType, status, reason, sanction_until AS sanctionUntil, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt FROM user_sanction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY FIELD(sanction_type, 'PERM_SUSPENDED', 'TEMP_SUSPENDED'), created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT us.sanction_id AS sanctionId, us.user_id AS userId, us.sanction_type AS sanctionType, us.status, us.reason, us.sanction_until AS sanctionUntil, us.created_by AS createdBy, creator.nickname AS createdByNickname, us.revoked_by AS revokedBy, revoker.nickname AS revokedByNickname, us.revoked_at AS revokedAt, us.revoke_reason AS revokeReason, us.created_at AS createdAt, us.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM user_sanction us JOIN user_account creator ON creator.user_id = us.created_by LEFT JOIN user_account revoker ON revoker.user_id = us.revoked_by WHERE us.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY us.created_at DESC, us.sanction_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_sanction SET status = 'REVOKED', revoked_by = #{revokedBy}, revoked_at = NOW(), revoke_reason = #{revokeReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE sanction_id = #{sanctionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE user_sanction SET status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND sanction_type = 'TEMP_SUSPENDED' AND sanction_until IS NOT NULL AND sanction_until <= NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_sanction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
